instructions:
## Objective

Detect cells and reconstruct temporal and division links in 3D microscopy recordings.

## Work to perform

Learn from annotated recordings and predict a different specimen. Provide integer voxel centroids and temporal links; encode a division as two outgoing links from its parent. Account for sparse annotations when designing local validation.

## Deliverable

CSV of detections and temporal/division links.

## Evaluation

Held-out tracking score using physical-distance matching, link agreement and a cell-count penalty. Detection without correct linking does not earn the corresponding link credit.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
